changelog:
### Multiplayer world synchronization

- Network matches now wait for the validated server-owned map, mode, team, seed, rules, rate, and
  content contract before constructing cars, arenas, objectives, pickups, or bots.
- Fresh joins and disconnect/reconnect cycles now construct a new synchronized world on Block Fort,
  Dust Pan, Soccer Pitch, and Suburbia.
- Player and respawn placement now uses the selected arena's spawn table on clients and servers.
- Remote cars cannot spawn or register before their handshake and synchronized world are ready.

### Combat consistency

- Offline and dedicated-server combat now share a three-second respawn policy.
- Added a real-build parity gate that runs the same Sniper sequence offline and against a pure
  dedicated server, comparing health, shields, primary and secondary ammunition, pickups,
  collision damage, death, respawn, and reload across 11 states.
- Fixed the first spawned car sometimes initializing as Scout before the saved class was loaded.
- Fixed stable network pickup ID collisions for mirrored Suburbia pickup positions.

### Validation and tooling

- Expanded the runtime release gate to all three standalone modes, all four host/client map-mode
  reconnect contracts, and a pure dedicated-server reconnect.
- Added machine-readable world-lifecycle and combat-parity reports that fail on mismatched state,
  managed errors, exceptions, missing reports, or shutdown hangs.
- Expanded the complete EditMode suite to 88 tests.

### Still in development

- Vehicle motion remains client-authored and server-validated; server input simulation, prediction,
  reconciliation, and processed-input acknowledgements are next-phase work.
- Bots still use a compatibility motor and gunner rather than the final shared server execution path.
- Public matchmaking, non-tailnet server access, complete authoritative objectives/late-join state,
  and large-server capacity validation are not part of this release.
